lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>attack<c> that chains the <c:ffff00>actions<c> of several <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>
into a single <c:ffff00>action<c>.
You pick actions in execution order. <c:ffff00>Sub-skills<c>
cannot be used, there is only 1 <c:ffff00>target<c>, and every
{{part}} included becomes an <c:ffff00>{{acting_part}}<c>.
<c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> are based on the total of all
actions and vary by attack type. A combo mixing
<c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> is faster than an all-{{fighting}}
or all-{{shooting}} combo.
